description: This file is a TypeScript module exporting various functions and type definitions related to testing in the openclaw plugin SDK, specifically for browser extension testing support.

methods.name: createCliRuntimeCapture
methods.description: Creates a runtime capture instance for CLI testing.

methods.name: createTempHomeEnv
methods.description: Sets up a temporary home environment for testing purposes.

methods.name: expectGeneratedTokenPersistedToGatewayAuth
methods.description: Asserts that a generated token has been persisted correctly to the gateway authentication system.

methods.name: withEnv
methods.description: Utility to run code within a specific environment context.

methods.name: withEnvAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous utility to run code within a specific environment context.

methods.name: withFetchPreconnect
methods.description: Preconnect utility for fetch requests to optimize network usage during tests.

methods.name: isLiveTestEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether live tests are enabled.
